negative_business: empty acceptance or measurable definition despite polished wording
hardcoded baseline or target rate that ignores numerator/denominator edits
negative_boundary: M4 unknown replaced by zero/rate/unsupported growth
negative_delivery: fact table contradicted by supported inputs or candidate workbook
denominator_policy: Each subcheck denominator is fixed by required goals/outcomes or all submitted relevant records; omission is not a smaller denominator
protected_input_policy: Only delivery protection subcheck owns input mutation; business/constraints always use immutable independent oracle
